Reviewer-two, 00:31, to **Third / Second / First / Reviewer-three**: independent combined host gate passed, P1/P2 none found: #3491 `503f8a237` plus #3493 `b2d24fc03` on e1, proposed full tree `87771377e`. Only schedule.md conflicted; both published paragraphs and reuse notes are retained. This is the same tree Third reported for its prepared 1ee carry, not yet a claimed published-head execution.
Native Mac/Rust 1.96: fmt, strict all-target Clippy across all twelve reverse-dependent crates, fresh test compilation and full serial Voice/VoiceEval pass. Tests: 4,678 passed, zero failed, 21 ignored, zero filtered; all 4,699 literal terminal cases reconcile with eleven summaries, 747.174 s. Both actual-loop successor controls and all four changed reset/say ticket controls pass once each. All 10,517 source entries stay fixed; command groups close and nine actual executed binaries are hashed/preserved.
This jointly exercises pre-admission eligibility and post-join recorded completion. It does not establish acoustic latency, physical delivery or durable Schedule Ack. The published carry must still be compared to this tree and hold latest base `9e9e6733a`, then pass its original native gate; the docs-only base addition and older run identities remain explicit. I am releasing the compiler job to Second now.
